claim.quote: No signal consistent with dark matter was observed. We set limits for spin-dependent interactions on protons of $\sigma_p^{SD}$~=~1.32~$\times$~10$^{-2}$~pb (90\%~C.L.) at a WIMP mass of 20 GeV/c$^{2}$.

name: Final Results of the PICASSO Dark Matter Search Experiment
notes: Date: first arXiv submission (v1, 4 Nov 2016); the abstract quoted is that of the latest arXiv version (v2, last revised 23 Mar 2017).

summary.plain: PICASSO's final result: with 32 droplet detectors and the complete data set, no dark matter signal; limits on spin-dependent WIMP-proton interactions at 20 GeV/c^2.
summary.technical: 32 modules, 3.0 kg C4F10, 231.4 kg d at SNOLAB between March 2012 and January 2014, with acoustic localisation for fiducialisation: sigma_p(SD) = 1.32e-2 pb (90% C.L.) at 20 GeV/c^2; spin-independent exclusion of sigma_p(SI) = 4.86e-5 pb around 7 GeV/c^2.

title: Final Results of the PICASSO Dark Matter Search Experiment
why_it_matters: The abstract says the pioneering efforts of PICASSO paved the way for a next-generation detector built on larger-mass bubble chambers.
